edited_artifact.subject: Re: Feedback request on proposal draft
edited_artifact.body:
Hi Fatoumata,

Thank you for the questions. Here is how the proposal we sent on October 31 breaks down:

- SecureData Nexus: 25 units at a 15% discount, $12,749.79
- CryptGuard Module: 20 units at a 15% discount, $8,329.83
- EduTech Lab: 10 units at a 10% discount, $3,599.91

The total is $24,679.53. I would also like to take you up on the call: would Monday, November 13 at 10:00 or Tuesday, November 14 at 14:00 suit you?

Best regards,
Luis
